newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NORTHERN SAYS MARGIN SQUEEZE CUTS PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: NORTHERN SAYS MARGIN SQUEEZE CUTS PROFIT.

text.p: Queensland-based Northern Building Society Ltd said on Monday that net profit after abnormals items fell 27 percent to A$3.4 million in the year ended June 30.
Northern said the results had been squeezed by a narrowing of interest rate margins as a result of intense competition in the home lending market.
The company said the unaudited results were released to keep the market informed ahead of its merger with the First Provincial Building Society and Sunstate Credit Union.
The three Queensland-based building societies said on July 31 they intended to merge and create the largest building society in the state. Details are expected to be released in early September.
Northern said to reduce the reliance on margin income it had introduced ongoing fees. However, non-interest expenses were able to be contained.
Total assets were a A$1 million higher at A$503 million.
Final dividend was eight cents a year, bringing the total dividend for the year to 16 cents per share.
